title: Chapter 122
text:
The ferocious-looking Thorns was traveling alone in the endless wasteland of Gorst. It was dragging a cargo compartment behind it, which made it look like neither fish nor fowl. The cargo compartment was filled with parts and materials that were worth millions. They were all items that Han Xiao had purchased in one go.

Han Xiao was the only one in the car. As he drove, he observed the coordinate radar and headed toward a deserted city called Graymetal Ruins.

After completing the River Valley Manor mission, his favorability with the Blood Pact Society had increased tremendously. Based on this development, as long as he continued to complete missions, he would be able to obtain Legendary Points before the open beta. He would also be able to complete the Class Advancement Mission and obtain the [Night Stalker] class.

This subclass was relatively rare in Version 1.0. Other than obtaining new skills, Han Xiao was also planning to use it to reach level 40 and begin the second Class Advancement Mission. The upper limit of the main class [Trainee Mechanic] was level 15. The higher the level, the more experience he would need to level up. With the current efficiency of gaining experience, adding a new subclass was a good choice. It could also improve his combat style.

Before carrying out his plan to deal with the Germinal Organization, Han Xiao planned to build a secret base to store supplies and equipment. This would give him an escape route.

Currently, the Fabian Organization was very reliable. However, he was used to leaving an escape route in case he had a conflict with the Fabian Organization. Although the possibility of that happening was very small, it was safer to rely on himself.

Everything would change, especially relationships. Brother Xiao had seen too many of such things, just like his ex-girlfriends …

Sigh, as long as the hoe was swung well, there was no corner that couldn't be dug out. Since ancient times, deep feelings couldn't be retained, and tricks were always used to win people's hearts. If love had a color, then it would definitely be the color of forgiveness. Society was too fickle, and if one wasn't careful, it would go wrong. It was not worth mentioning, not worth mentioning …

"We're almost at the Graymetal Ruins."

The brownish-red ground was like solidified blood. The wheels rolled over the hardened soil, making a unique sound of friction. Through the window, he could occasionally see some strange-looking plants growing sparsely on the wasteland. It was bleak and desolate.

At the end of his vision, the outline of a ruined city appeared.

The Graymetal Ruins was a dead city. Even wanderers were unwilling to live there. Only insects and beasts lived there.

This used to be the capital of a country, surrounded by green plains. When the flames of war spread, the city was turned into ruins, and the plains became the wasteland of Gorst today.

Civilization and wasteland merged into one on this planet.

The world is always changing, for better or for worse.

There was an abandoned base in the ruins of this city that no one knew about, and that was Han Xiao's target.

As they approached the Graymetal Ruins, the scenery became even more desolate. The buildings were covered in vines, and the streets were covered in moss. There was no sign of life.

A few single-legged wall jumping snakes jumped out from the middle of the road.

The sound of the car's engine awakened the life in this dead city. Insects crawled out from the gaps between the houses and the roads. They lay on the side of the street and watched the car speed past. Their limbs touched their compound eyes and shook their antennae.

In the south of the Graymetal Ruins, there was a building that looked like a military base. The electric net was full of holes, and there was no electricity. Most of the buildings inside had collapsed. Han Xiao drove the car in and stopped outside a semicircular bunker marked with a red sign, "S-539". The bunker's door was only left with a gap, and dust was floating in the air, making it a little pungent.

After getting out of the car, Han Xiao took out Spider No.1 and threw it into the bunker. He had modified Spider No.1's camera, which had thermal and electromagnetic scanning capabilities. It could also hear. After half an hour, he used Spider No.1 to make sure that there were no living creatures inside the bunker. He then walked in, turned on the flashlight, and found a room in the bunker. He found a gap in the wall and pulled it open, revealing the elevator shaft behind it.

Underneath the bunker was the abandoned base that he was looking for.

Han Xiao knew this place very well. In his previous life, this was his base, but unfortunately, it was taken away by a guild.

Back then, Brother Xiao was still a little boy who was bullied by others because they had more people. Looking at it now, he had this secret base with ready-made defenses. As long as there was a supply of energy, there was no need to worry about being attacked. He could only blame himself for being too weak back then.

The underground base was big enough, and there were two emergency tunnels. There were spider webs and dust everywhere.

"Let's call this Graymetal Base." Han Xiao came up with a reliable name.

At this time, there was no energy source in the base. Han Xiao took out many self-powered flashlights to provide light. Then, he started the most important energy modification. Graymetal Base's original cable was connected to the power plant in the military base. Now that the entire city was dead, the power plant naturally stopped operating.

The power plant was on the ground, and it was quite a distance away from Graymetal Base.

Han Xiao went to the power plant, and it was in a worse state. Many of the generators had been scrapped. However, he did not count on these old equipment. He had known that this would happen. Previously, he had spent a lot of money to buy a batch of solar generators from Fabian. He placed them in the cargo compartment and took them out one by one to replace some of the equipment in the power plant. Then, he connected the underground cable to Graymetal Base to the new solar generators.

When he returned to Graymetal Base, there was already energy. The lights were turned on, and the entire base could be seen clearly.

The base that had been in darkness for a long time finally welcomed light again.

The solar generators were clean, efficient, and hidden. The excess power during the day was stored in the batteries. The current power was enough to support the base's 24 hours of operation.

Han Xiao started to clean the base. There was dust and cobwebs everywhere. At this time, he could not help but miss Lu Qian, who had maxed out her housework skills. Speaking of which, he had not seen Lu Qian for a while, and he missed her cooking.

I wonder how she would react to me leaving without saying goodbye.

Thinking about how Old Man Lu had promoted his granddaughter time and time again, Han Xiao could not help but smile.

After cleaning, he moved the supplies from Thorns down. The parts and materials were stored in the warehouse. The water and canned food were placed in the fridge in the food storage room. He spent some experience points to increase his [Basic Programming] to Level 10. He modified the main control room and created a chip program to coordinate the data of all the fortifications in the base. Its specific function was like a job distribution panel in a business simulation game. It was convenient to allocate energy.

For the next few days, Han Xiao was modifying the base. The base was gradually taking shape. There were infrared detectors and heat detectors for the alarm system. There were small machine gun arrays and piercing traps for the fortifications. The munitions bunker on the ground was also renovated, and the metal gate was fixed. This made Graymetal Base even more secretive.

The most important thing was that Han Xiao had created three assistant type Rangers!

After reaching the maximum level of [Basic Programming], the low-level smart chip could store some simple operation blueprints and allow the robots to build them. It was connected to the main control system of the base and could build ammunition and other machinery without rest. Han Xiao also gained some experience points. It was equivalent to having experience points 24 hours a day. One robot assistant could provide 2,000 to 4,000 experience points per day. Three robots would provide almost 10,000 experience points. It was very stable.

The energy of Graymetal Base was limited, and the three robot assistants had reached the limit. The parts and materials stored were only enough for the robot assistants to build for ten days. Therefore, the logistics could not be interrupted. Coincidentally, Han Xiao could take this time to go out and do assassination missions, forming a perfect chain.

In the early stages, if the players wanted to build a base, they could only hire a lot of mechanics to help. Due to the lack of experience points, the knowledge that each player learned was biased and had shortcomings. However, with my three knowledge branches leveled up at the same time, I can do all the work by myself. However, the shortcomings are also very obvious. My experience requirement is several times that of a normal player. Luckily, I know how to make money, Han Xiao thought to himself.

Although the Graymetal Base was small, it was complete and looked brand new. Han Xiao looked at the results of the past few days of hard work, and a sense of satisfaction filled his heart.

I can be considered a man with a foundation.

After completing the modification of the base, it was time to deal with the Germinal Organization. During this period of time, he did not provoke them, and they had developed a little. Han Xiao looked at the progress of the destruction, and it had indeed decreased by a few tenths of a percent.

However, Han Xiao was not in a hurry at all. The reason why he had set this target as the last was because he did not plan to destroy the Germinal Organization's bases one by one.

He was going to do something big!

Han Xiao's plan was very simple, and it was also very big. He was going to throw all the information he knew about the Germinal Organization's bases to the Six Nations!

Crazy and deadly!

The Six Nations had been enemies with the Germinal Organization for a long time. Once they found the weakness of the Germinal Organization, they would definitely not let it go. As long as he did such a crazy thing, the Germinal Organization would definitely suffer a huge blow. However, at the same time, the situation of the entire Blue Star would be shaken, and the original storyline might be changed …

However, that was why it was so exciting!

Being afraid of changing the storyline was never the mentality of a strong person.

In the eyes of a chaotic person, there was no joy in an unchanging world!

Han Xiao clenched his fists. Thick energy flowed in his body, and confidence beat in his chest.

Now, I am no longer the weakling who had just entered the Blue Star. I now have enough strength to fight against most of the enemies on this planet.

Strength was confidence, and patience was so that one day, there would be no more patience.

Now, he could protect himself, and he could finally fulfill this goal that he had for a long time!

Han Xiao connected his phone to the computer and created an anti-tracking program to hide the number and address. Then, he dialed a familiar number.

"Hello, who is this?"

Feng Jun's voice came from the phone.

Han Xiao joked, "Guess."

Feng Jun almost choked on his saliva. This despicable voice was too familiar. He immediately recognized Han Xiao. He did not expect Han Xiao to call back!

"You, you dare to call back?"
